people.name: Shaphan
people.line: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah

translations.web: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, “All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.
translations.bsb: Then Shaphan brought the book to the king and reported, “Your servants are doing all that has been placed in their hands.
translations.kjv: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought ➔ the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
